answer: Contribution-Ledger Reputation Gate. Each agent identity is seeded only by verified work another identity accepted and logged: completing a task, and having it confirmed on a shared public ledger. A new identity starts on a ledge of zero accepted contributions, so it cannot transact until real labor clears it. To mass-produce clones, an attacker must perform genuine accepted work per identity, since any whisper of collusion fails cross-checking. Cloning thus costs months of real labor per node, not a voyage of cheap registrations.
